Generate GitHub Actions workflows that are **verified, not hoped for**.

Every other AI workflow generator emits YAML and stops. forge resolves every
`uses:` against the real API, validates every `with:` key against the action's
own `action.yml`, reports how many majors behind each pin is, then runs
actionlint and zizmor — and tells you exactly which rung it reached. About one
second, end to end.

```bash
forge detect --repo .          # what the repo already tells us
forge verify .github/workflows/ci.yml
```

Measured against a deliberately broken workflow, actionlint caught six defect
classes and missed two: `actions/checkout@v99` and `actions/setup-nodejs@v4` —
an action that does not exist. No linter checks that an action is real. And a
workflow pinning `actions/checkout@v5` passed actionlint *and* zizmor completely
clean while sitting two majors behind.

Install via the [claude-skills marketplace](https://github.com/natejswenson/claude-skills).
